lines.en: I lift a foot; dust falls from my seams.
Stare ahead, silent.

lines.zh: 我是用虚空之眼搭出来的。
lines.en: I was built from a void eye.
Search for prey, look around.
Move with caution.
I count how often you raise that pick.
Heavy steps, careful every step.
Quiet, power builds.
Step with alertness.
I shift a step, eye never blinking.
The monolith lifts a foot; dust falls.
A two-block shadow shifts.
Gaze into the void.
The black in my eye turns once.
Mutter a low sound.
Breathe slowly, like the night.
Gaze deep, like a black hole.
Stare at the light in the darkness.
Stand quietly, observe everything.
Breathe silently.
Deep eyes look into the distance.
Still, like a statue.
A faint light pulses in its stone chest.
The prophet whispers inside the stone.
The Void Eye turns slowly.
It stands still, like a wall.
Suddenly turn, lock on the player.
Gaze shift, focus on the player.
One eye is all I need to watch you.

lines.zh: 目光转向玩家，无声警告。
lines.en: Eyes turn to the player, silent warning.
Look at the player, issue a warning.
Turn head towards the player, alert.
Lock eyes, unmovable.
Eyes lock on the player, silent.
Stare down the player, no escape.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，无声地威胁。
lines.en: Eyes fix on the player, silent threat.
Its stone eye turns to you.

lines.zh: 你亲手拼出的它，记得你
lines.en: You built it; it remembers you.
It lowers its head to stare.
The eye on the monolith never blinks.
Made by you, and now roused by you.
An interrogating light leaks from its seams.
It is reading your breathing.
A pickaxe can hurt it, and it knows.
You are standing too close.
There is no warmth in that gaze.
My vision is blurring...
The pick's mark stays on my face.
My eyes...
I'm losing my luster...
I'm weakening...
I can't see with my eyes...
My light is fading...
I'm decaying...
My vision is contracting...
My sight is blurring...
Draw you into my sight!
You cannot escape my gaze!
Feel the darkness I bring!
Your world shall vanish!
You built me with your own hands.

lines.zh: 我的洞穴深处埋藏着秘密！
lines.en: My cavern holds secrets!

lines.zh: 这里没有光明，只有黑暗！
lines.en: There's no light here, only darkness!
You cannot comprehend my power!
I watch you from here!
Darkness will consume all!
Stay away from my domain!
You've touched my line!
You struck me. The stone didn't move.
Raise the monolith and I arrive.
Leave, or you'll die!
You've shattered the illusion of peace!
My wrath shall be realized!

lines.zh: 我的存在是对抗不了的！
lines.en: My existence cannot be resisted!

lines.zh: 你的入侵将被彻底摧毁！
lines.en: Your invasion will be utterly destroyed!
This is my domain, go away!

lines.zh: 再来一块独石，就有伴了。
lines.en: One more monolith would give me company.

lines.zh: 两块独石认得同一只眼。
lines.en: Two monoliths know the same eye.

lines.zh: 我的配偶，与我共享力量！
lines.en: My mate, share my power!
Explore the edges of darkness together!
My power comes from my mate!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，我的力量源泉！
lines.en: My mate, my source of power!
Experience fear with me!
My existence is for breeding!

lines.zh: 我立在这儿，就是一根柱子。
lines.en: Standing here, I am a pillar.
Rule this darkness together!
Your touch intrudes on my sight!
Your presence unsettles me.

lines.zh: 你的举动引起了我的注意。
lines.en: Your movements have caught my interest.
Do not divert my gaze.

lines.zh: 你被包围在了我的视界里。
lines.en: You are enmeshed in my vision.
Your hand has touched my stone.
Your voice echoes in the shadows.

lines.zh: 你的行动引来了我的注意。
lines.en: Your actions draw my attention.
You try to hide from me.

lines.zh: 你的存在破坏了我的专注。
lines.en: Your presence distracts my focus.
Prey in sight.
I watch you.
I was assembled just to watch you.
You back into a corner; I'm still watching.
My prey, you cannot escape.
You are chosen.
Your struggle is in vain.
You will fall into my grasp.
Wait for my command.
You are in my eyes.
Its maker has become prey.
The monolith stirs and locks on.

lines.zh: 你被自己造的东西盯上
lines.en: You are stalked by your own creation.
The eye lights up; you can't leave.
It has recorded your position.
Two blocks of pure intent to kill.
Every eye on the pillar faces you.
You are targeted.
My gaze follows you.
My gaze is fixed on you.
My gaze is upon you.

lines.zh: 我的视线追踪你的每一步。
lines.en: My gaze follows your every step.
My observation is on you.
My gaze does not leave you.
Your actions are under watch.

lines.zh: 我的目光锁定你的行动。
lines.en: My gaze is fixed on your movements.
The prophet's eye counts your seconds.
You step back; it steps forward.
Stone needs no breath.
Can you still lift that pickaxe?
It waits for you to move first.
The black in its eye is spreading.

lines.zh: 注视，就是你最后的自由
lines.en: Being watched is your last freedom.
The stone has mapped your retreat.
It remembers the bricks you broke.
The stare holds; the verdict waits.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的嘶嘶声，露出锋利的牙齿。
lines.en: Hisses lowly, showing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 挥舞双臂，准备扑向目标。
lines.en: Waves his arms, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 用独石和虚空之眼的光芒照亮黑暗。
lines.en: Illuminates the darkness with obsidian and Void Eyes.
Tear the target into pieces.

lines.zh: 瞪大眼睛，锁定下一个猎物。
lines.en: Larger eyes, locking on the next prey.
Pounces and devours the prey.

lines.zh: 发出痛苦的嘶吼，挣扎着移动。
lines.en: Roars in pain, struggling to move.

lines.zh: 用独石和先知的智慧攻击。
lines.en: Attacks with obsidian and the wisdom of the prophet.
Tear the prey into meat chunks.

lines.zh: 挥舞着虚空之眼寻找猎物。
lines.en: Waving Void Eyes to find prey.
The monolith slams down; the ground shakes.
A stone fist sweeps past, hissing.
Its eye flares and burns your sight.
Two blocks of weight come down.
Stone fingers dig into your shoulder.
This blow is one you assembled.
The monolith rises and I straighten with it.
Steps out of the shadows.
Silently moves in the darkness.

lines.zh: 悄无声息地出现在角落。
lines.en: Appears silently in the corner.
Slowly appears from the crack.
Appears in the shadows secretly.

lines.zh: 从黑暗的深处缓缓升起。
lines.en: Rises slowly from the dark depths.
Crawls out of the ground.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中悄无声息地走动。
lines.en: Walks silently in the darkness.
Appears silently.
The monolith lands; the Overseer takes shape.
One right-click, and the eye opens.
Prophet and Void Eye fuse into one.
The wall you built stands up.
A two-block shadow rises.
A stare grows out of the stone.
By the crafting table, it watches you.
The watcher you woke with your own hands.
The floor cracks; stones gather.
The monolith hums; the eye ignites.
The flames sear my eyes!

lines.zh: 从两格高处摔下来，石头震了。
lines.en: A fall from two blocks rattles my stone.
The dark water devours me!
The explosion rips my flesh!
Even a monolith-built me can hurt.
The spell destroys me!
Starvation weakens me!
Lightning severs my life!
My stone sinks and my light dims.
